(run_dir / 'metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2) + '\n')
subprocess.run(['python3', str(skill_dir / 'scripts/run-log.py'), 'event', '--run-dir', str(run_dir), '--end', 'report'], check=True)
subprocess.run(['python3', str(skill_dir / 'scripts/run-log.py'), 'summarize', '--run-dir', str(run_dir)], check=True)
